blocks.text: Item 3 on Robert's list can come off. Michelle went back through the treaty documents in your first set of files and found an amendment to that treaty's rate schedule, effective partway through the quarter in question. The reinsurer's statement applies the amended rates from that point on. The {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} listing appears to apply the old rates for the full quarter.

That would account for the difference, but it is our reading of two documents, not a confirmed answer. We will not treat it as settled until we have your team's reply on items 1 and 2. If the booked figure does reflect the old rates, it would also help to know whether a correcting entry is planned.
